$comment: Instrument/pickup profiles. `aliases` are matched in the prompt by engine/parse (longest phrase wins). `archetypeBias` is added to archetype scores. `corrections` is a list of groups applied by engine/solve; a group with `archetypes` only applies to those archetypes. In each group `models` overrides archetype model choice (vocabulary models still win), `enable` turns blocks on after vocabulary toggles, and `deltas` are additive raw 0-100 steps on canonical <block>.<param> keys (params the chosen model lacks are skipped). 10-band EQ raw steps are 0.3 dB (raw 50 = 0 dB); cab lowcut raw r = 20 + 2.8r Hz.

electric-single-coil.label: Electric guitar, single-coil pickups
notes: Lower output and 60-cycle hum: raise the gate sensitivity, more so as gain rises.
Brighter than humbuckers: shave a little treble to avoid ice-pick at higher gain.

electric-humbucker.label: Electric guitar, humbuckers
notes: Hotter, darker output: slightly less gain and bass, a little more treble than a single-coil prior.

electric-p90.label: Electric guitar, P-90 pickups
notes: Single-coil hum with humbucker-like output; mild gate, slightly smoother top.

acoustic-piezo.label: Acoustic guitar, under-saddle piezo
notes: Piezo quack lives around 1-2 kHz: cut 1K (-2.4 dB) and 2K (-3 dB).
Passive piezo into a 1 MOhm input sounds thin: add a little 250 Hz body and tame the 8 kHz zing.

acoustic-magnetic.label: Acoustic guitar, soundhole magnetic pickup
notes: Magnetic soundhole pickups pair best with an acoustic body sim (G-HBIRD).
They are boomy at 125 Hz and lack air: cut 125, lift 4K/8K.

mandolin-magnetic.label: Electric mandolin, stacked humbucker
notes: Stacked humbucker is quiet: keep the gate light so the short mandolin decay is not chopped.
Mandolin has no useful content below ~100 Hz; raise low cut instead of boosting bass.

mandolin-acoustic.label: Acoustic mandolin (mic or transducer)
notes: Cut 125 Hz boom and some 2 kHz quack; high low-cut keeps it out of the bass register.
